user.title: Smart Heating Schedule
user.description: Adds a Smart Heating Schedule page to the sidebar where you create weekly home and away schedules for your thermostats.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration possible.

data.admin_only: Only show the panel to administrators

data_description.presence_entity: Decides between the home and away schedules when the presence mode is Auto. A zone counts as away when nobody is in it; a person, device tracker or group when it is not home; a binary sensor or input boolean when it is off.
data_description.admin_only: Non-admin users can view schedules but never change them.

not_loaded.message: Smart Heating Schedule is not set up.

init.title: Thermostat {entity_id} no longer exists
init.description: A smart schedule exists for {entity_id}, but that entity was removed. Move the schedule to another thermostat, or delete it.

menu_options.reassign: Move the schedule to another thermostat

reassign.title: Move schedule
reassign.description: Choose the thermostat that should get the schedule of {entity_id}.

remove.title: Delete schedule
remove.description: The schedule of {entity_id} will be deleted.

resume_schedule.name: Resume schedule
resume_schedule.description: Applies the current time block again, undoing manual changes made on the thermostat.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Returns the home and away schedule of a thermostat.

entity_id.name: Thermostat
entity_id.description: The climate entity whose schedule to return.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Creates or replaces the schedule of a thermostat. Use the output of Get schedule as an example.

home.name: Home schedule
home.description: The week schedule used when someone is home.

away.name: Away schedule
away.description: The week schedule used when nobody is home.
